role: Piagetian situated-to-categorical knowledge progression mechanics via scope_context_count.
detail: Core module for semantic knowledge maturation: ScopeContextMechanics class tracks when re-assertions of edges occur in genuinely different ConversationContexts to increment scope_context_count (contextual diversity, not utterance frequency). Key functions: increment_scope_count() increments only on context change, filtering same-session repetition; get_categorical_threshold() reads from CATEGORICAL_KNOWLEDGE_THRESHOLD EvolutionRule (default 3, guardian-tunable); compute_inference_hop_limit() returns max IS_A/PART_OF traversal depth modulated by scope_context_count (1 hop at count=1, 2 at count=2, 5/MAX at count>=threshold) and optionally by homeostatic arousal (>0.7 adds 1 hop, <0.3 removes 1); filter_episodic_statement() detects past-event narratives (episodic) vs general claims (semantic) via prefix matching on 89 episodic markers. ensure_categorical_threshold_rule() idempotently seeds the EvolutionRule node. Event publishing on scope increment. Developmental grounding: count=1 (situated, hedged), count=2 (cross-context comparison), count>=3 (categorical, generalizable). Phase 1.8 (P1.8-E2/T005). CANON A.1, A.18, A.20.
constants: _EPISODIC_MARKERS=(tuple of 23 marker strings like 'i saw', 'i heard', 'yesterday', 'today i', etc.)
gotchas: filter_episodic_statement uses conservative prefix-matching (false positives less harmful than false negatives); compute_inference_hop_limit homeostatic modulation clamps between 1 and MAX_HOP_LIMIT; same_session_repetition guard at line 251 prevents count gaming; event publishing at line 438 silently logs warnings on failure rather than raising
